cohort: 25 women experiencing atonic postpartum haemorrhage during caesarian delivery unresponsive to oxytocics.
finding: Combined bilateral uterine artery ligation and modified B-lynch brace suture application controlled atonic PPH in 96% of cases (24/25), with one case requiring hysterectomy due to cardiovascular instability.
followup_time: Until subsequent pregnancies/menstrual function observation in available follow-up (17/25 patients).
